name: Rinasclta Q-AERO GR
why_interesting: A current 50C direct frameset with T47, UDH, per-size painted weights and a manufacturer-described aero/Wind Eye shell.
missing: Current mainland-CNY selected-option price and stock

facts.frame: T800/T1000-claimed carbon with manufacturer Q-AERO/Wind Eye marketing
facts.frame_material: Toray T800 + T1000 carbon fiber; no exact ply schedule or resin system is published
facts.frame_construction: Aerodynamic gravel frame with Wind Eye seatstay opening, 1.5-inch straight head tube, T47 86.5 mm shell, UDH and 27.2 mm round seatpost
facts.stiffness_evidence: The manufacturer describes efficient power transfer, drivetrain stability and front-end stiffness, but publishes no exact-model deflection protocol or independent stiffness result
facts.frame_weight_basis: Size 52/S, UD black paint, 1,200 g ±20 g; exact manufacturer size table lists 1,180/1,200/1,220/1,240/1,260 g for 49/52/54/56/58. A separate generic “Weight 5 kg” field is unlabeled and is not treated as frame weight.
facts.purchase_route: Current global manufacturer-direct product page with size/finish options and add-to-cart; no mainland-China checkout, landed cost or local purchase route verified.
facts.warranty: Manufacturer policy states two-year frame/manufacturing-defect coverage with proof of purchase, frame identification and warranty form; man-made damage is excluded. Shipping language conflicts: opening terms say manufacturer-paid return shipping for manufacturing defects, later terms say buyer pays shipping for a quality issue. Confirm terms before relying on shipping coverage.

source_note:
Official painted frame weights are 1,180/1,200/1,220/1,240/1,260 g for sizes 49/52/54/56/58, each ±20 g. The package includes frame, fork, seatpost, headset, clamp, thru axles and hanger. Manufacturer aero language is retained as marketing evidence, not an independent drag result.

Batch 36 recheck: current manufacturer page confirms SKU RF-QA-GR-27, Toray T800+T1000 claim, 700×50C limit, global direct-store options, and size/finish weights. Size 52/S UD black is 1,200 g ±20 g; the page also shows 1,180/1,200/1,220/1,240/1,260 g for sizes 49/52/54/56/58. A separate unlabeled “Weight 5 kg” field is not treated as frame weight. Warranty says two years but its shipping provisions conflict internally.
